Senior Backend Engineer

Northwind is building payment infrastructure for marketplaces. You will own services that move real money, end to end.

What you'll do

  • Design and operate Go and Python services handling ledgering and reconciliation at high volume.
  • Lead the migration of our settlement pipeline onto event-driven infrastructure backed by Kafka.
  • Partner with compliance on PCI-DSS scope reduction and audit readiness across the platform.

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years building backend systems in production, ideally in payments or another regulated domain.
  • Deep experience with PostgreSQL, including partitioning and query tuning under load.
  • Hands-on Kubernetes and Terraform experience; you are comfortable owning your own deploys.
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar on a team.
